verdict.rationale: Serving embedding models is a fair question for a local model-serving runtime like LocalAI, so the axis applies. The pack never mentions embeddings, an /embeddings endpoint, or retrieval/search use. A general OpenAI-compatible API and a list of text, voice, vision, image and video modalities do not show that embedding models are served, so no credit is given.

support.subject: As a developer, I can serve embedding models for retrieval and search applications
